def check(candidate):
    import tempfile
    from pathlib import Path

    print(candidate("nonexistent_directory"))

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        directory = Path(temp_dir)

        print(candidate(temp_dir))

        )
        (directory / "other.txt").write_text(

        )
        (directory / "ignored.md").write_text(
            "This file should be ignored", encoding="utf-8"
        )

        print(candidate(temp_dir))
        print(candidate(temp_dir, r"\(\w+\)|\d"))

        nested = directory / "nested"
        nested.mkdir()
        print(candidate(str(nested)))
